subject: general
question: Which new mission has been announced in the Union Budget of India, 2021, for exceptional opportunities in mapping. exploring and utilising the oceanic resources?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deep Ocean Mission.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Deep Ocean Mission is a new mission announced in the Union Budget of India, 2021, which aims to explore and utilize the oceanic resources in a sustainable manner.
 
• **The mission will focus on deep-sea mining, ocean climate change advisory services, underwater vehicles and underwater robotics, and ocean exploration.**
 
• The mission is expected to provide a boost to the Blue Economy of India, which refers to the sustainable use of ocean resources for economic growth, job creation, and environmental sustainability.
 
• **The mission will also contribute to India's deep-sea scientific research capabilities and strengthen its maritime security.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Samundra Setu Mission is a mission launched by the Indian Navy in 2020.
 
 
• **It aimed to repatriate Indian citizens stranded abroad during the COVID-19 pandemic.**
 
 
 
• Blue Economy Mission is related to the Deep Ocean Mission as it aims to promote sustainable use of ocean resources for economic growth, job creation, and environmental sustainability.
 
• Maritime Exercise Mission refers to joint exercises conducted by the Indian Navy with other navies.
 
 
• **It is done to enhance maritime security and interoperability.**
